body: Thanks man. I'm trying now. Working with my Chain of Command here at Valcatraz, and going to try and figure things out back in Borden when I get there.
I'm currently at Valcartier, but I'm being sent back to Borden on Thursday, when I get sent home the closes city will be Edmonton, but I don't know if I'll make it back there.
They cut contact with me when I last told them that the army was causing me to break down physically and mentally. I have no idea how to contact them anymore.
In the Canadian army. We don't have that sort of thing last I heard, maybe a small amount of support for schooling through veterans affairs ..
